Welcome to the official YouTube channel of John Gibbons, known worldwide as the BODYMASTER®.

John is a UK-qualified Osteopath, international lecturer, and author. Through his videos, John shares his clinical experience to help therapists and anyone interested in the human body better understand anatomy, injury assessment and treatment techniques.
Explore practical demonstrations and educational content covering joint biomechanics, muscle function, sports injuries, kinesiology taping, mobilisation, manipulation, and exercise therapy.
John is the creator of the Bodymaster Method®, an advanced training programme for therapists including Osteopaths, Chiropractors, Physiotherapists, Sports Therapists, Athletic Trainers, and other healthcare professionals. 
Thank you for subscribing and supporting the channel. Your continued interest inspires me to keep producing educational content and sharing my passion for helping people understand the amazing complexity of the human body.
Cheers,
JG
